message:
Kristol, anonymous, and Patti, I really agree with you -- something needs to be done to make people realize how terrible [T-Netix](http://www.t-netix.com/) is, and how their cashing in on the suffering of inmates' families violates the Constitution's [Eighth Amendment](http://www.lectlaw.com/def/c182.htm). Suing T-Netix and/or the prison system might be one way to do it; so might getting in touch with your congressional representatives. Tell you what: let's all do some research on how we might go about doing that, since it'll help other inmates' families, too. One place I'm going to start with: the [American Civil Liberties Union](http://www.aclu.org/Prisons/PrisonsMain.cfm), since they have a great history of helping people who can't afford lawyers. I hope you might contact them, too, and feel free to refer them to this Web site.

Let's bankrupt the [T-Netix](http://www.t-netix.com/) vultures.
